description: This file defines a service function getNewUsersOverTime that aggregates new user creation counts over specified time intervals (day, week, month) using MongoDB aggregation. It includes helper functions for date bucketing and formatting, and exports the main function.

methods.name: getNewUsersOverTime
methods.description: Aggregates user creation counts over time with specified granularity and date range, returning structured points data.

methods.name: fillMissingBuckets
methods.description: Fills in missing time buckets between start and end dates for day, week, or month granularity, merging with existing data.

methods.name: setToStartOfDayUTC
methods.description: Sets a Date object to the start of the day in UTC.

methods.name: startOfMonthUTC
methods.description: Returns a Date object representing the start of the month in UTC for a given date.

methods.name: startOfISOWeekUTC
methods.description: Returns a Date object representing the start of the ISO week (Monday) in UTC for a given date.

methods.name: pad2
methods.description: Pads a number with leading zero if necessary to ensure two digits.

methods.name: weekNumberISO
methods.description: Calculates the ISO week number and year for a given date.

methods.name: formatISOWeek
methods.description: Formats a week start date into ISO week string (e.g., '2024-W01').
